item.text: {"paper_id":"paper003","profile_id":"neuroscience","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"Three high-level themes were constructed: 1) inequitable stroke care and rehabilitation services, 2) barriers to the provision and access of stroke services and 3) desires, needs and opportunities for improvement.","rationale":"The study directly addresses stroke, an explicit profile interest, by examining care providers’ experiences, rehabilitation access, and opportunities to improve support following stroke.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
